verdicts.reason: Both squeeze the poster into a 320x50 strip. In both, the description and venue copy render at about 4px, which is unreadable. The logo mark is gone, the RSVP CTA has shrunk into a tiny pill or a line of fine print, and the pills, body copy and date compete as one cramped cluster. B is worse because it also carries the original's grey/red placeholder box into the lower right, where it jams against the body text and the canvas edge.
